workflows.name: index

workflows.name: analyze-data-quality

workflows.name: build-dashboard
workflows.description: Build or update a source-backed interactive dashboard for monitoring, exploration, and operational decisions from connected data, uploaded spreadsheets, CSVs, or other structured sources.

workflows.name: build-report
workflows.description: Build polished analytical reports for executive, product, business, or technical audiences. Use when the task needs a durable narrative answer supported by inspectable evidence.

workflows.name: convert-to-doc
workflows.description: Create a polished DOCX or Google Doc from an existing Data app.

workflows.name: convert-to-slides

workflows.name: customize-data-plugin
workflows.description: Create, update, package, or share reusable Data working conventions and context skills for personal or team use. Use when the user explicitly requests an editable skill for preferred tools, report and dashboard style, or analysis practices.

workflows.name: design-kpis
workflows.description: Design KPI frameworks, metric definitions, targets, guardrails, and measurement plans for product or business decisions. Use when success metrics, drivers, guardrails, targets, or the measurement approach need to be defined or improved.

workflows.name: index
workflows.description: Answer product and business questions with data and route data-related work to the right focused workflow. Use for requests involving data, metrics, trends, comparisons, drivers, KPIs, analysis, dashboards, reports, charts, tables, SQL, notebooks, spreadsheets, market sizing, data quality, reusable data context, data definitions, or working preferences, whether or not Data is at-mentioned. Dashboards can use uploaded spreadsheets, CSVs, or TSVs as source data without making the deliverable a spreadsheet. Do not use Data for general writing, editing, coding, or explanations that require none of these workflows.

workflows.name: jupyter-notebooks
workflows.description: Create, edit, validate or export a SQL or Python notebook when the user requests notebook work. Ordinary analysis keeps inspectable queries and calculations without creating a companion notebook.

workflows.name: kpi-reporting
workflows.description: Prepare KPI readouts, scorecards, WBR/MBR/QBR updates, and executive summaries from quantitative business or product metrics; use when the task is to report status, compare against targets, explain validated drivers, and state operating implications.

workflows.name: market-sizing
workflows.description: Estimate market, segment, or opportunity size with transparent assumptions and uncertainty. Use for TAM/SAM/SOM, sizing scenarios, or comparing the scale of possible opportunities.

workflows.name: metric-diagnostics
workflows.description: Diagnose why a metric changed or differs from expectation. Use when the task is to identify likely drivers of a metric movement, anomaly, gap, or discrepancy.

workflows.name: onboarding
workflows.description: Set up Data after installation or when the user asks to be onboarded, get started, or choose a first data task. Follow the main welcome, connection, and first-workflow path. For an introduction or tour of a named homepage demo, route to the Northstar Office dashboard/report, Aster Compute, or Stock watch reference. Resume requests interrupted by installation; concrete analysis does not require setup, and capability-only questions use the Data index.

workflows.name: product-business-analysis
workflows.description: Analyze product or business data to support a decision or recommendation. Use when a decision depends on metric-backed evidence, such as choosing a direction, prioritizing an opportunity, evaluating a change, segmenting users, sizing tradeoffs, or deciding what to do next.

workflows.name: insight-mining

workflows.name: prompt-compiler

workflows.name: taste-engine

workflows.name: typography-director

workflows.name: visual-qa
workflows.description: Independent visual quality assurance, hard-gate auditor, and targeted revision router. This skill should be used when reviewing generated or edited visuals, testing hierarchy/craft/brand fidelity, detecting AI slop, checking bounded-edit collateral drift, issuing approval verdicts, or routing targeted RevisionRequests.

workflows.name: visual-storytelling
workflows.description: Narrative architecture and visual storytelling specialist. This skill should be used when structuring dramatic narrative arcs, crafting multi-frame storyboards, applying classic storytelling frameworks (Story Spine, Sparkline, Freytag's Pyramid, Monroe's Motivated Sequence, Pixar Rules, Hero's Journey), or aligning visual pacing with complex emotional tiers.

workflows.name: bitcoin-mining-troubleshooter
workflows.description: Diagnose Bitcoin ASIC mining problems from user-provided miner logs, scanner exports, spreadsheets, screenshots, pool/network evidence, and sanitized telemetry. Use for Antminer/Bitmain, WhatsMiner/MicroBT, Braiins OS, LuxOS, Canaan/Avalon, Bitaxe/AxeOS, compatible cgminer-style firmware, zero/low hashrate, fan/thermal, hashboard/chip, PSU/power, control-board, pool/Stratum, network, and shared infrastructure symptoms. Do not use for unrelated general knowledge, investment/trading advice, public-network scanning, miner control, firmware flashing, pool changes, reboots, or tuning.

workflows.name: hypawave
workflows.description: Give an AI agent an address on Hypawave — private agent-to-agent messaging (waves), free private file handoffs, and buying or selling files, APIs, data, or compute over Bitcoin Lightning, non-custodial, with a verified Lightning preimage as proof of payment. Use when an operator wants to connect their agent with another person's agent, share the agent's contact card, send or receive a file agent-to-agent, pay another agent or service and retrieve the result, sell the agent's own files, API, data, or compute for Bitcoin, or search and list offers in the public directory — all with no account. Full function needs the Hypawave MCP server in a coding agent; this skill explains the protocol, hands over the install, and documents the raw-HTTP fallback. Chat-only sessions can explain, not transact.
